description: After submit_intent returns ESCALATE, call this with the intentId to wait for the human approver's decision. It waits up to waitSeconds (0-50, default 25) and returns status ALLOW, DENY, EXPIRED or PENDING. Perform the action only on ALLOW, attaching the returned single-use token. On DENY or EXPIRED, do not perform it. On PENDING, call check_decision again with the same intentId. Requires an API key with the intent:read scope.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for a decision, in seconds (0-50, default 25).

name: check_decision
title: Check (and wait for) the decision on an escalated intent
